reports.title: THE BUCKLE, INC. REPORTS THIRD QUARTER NET INCOME

desk.headline: Sales up 2.6% to $329.2m, below estimate; diluted EPS $0.94 vs $0.96, above estimate; no guidance
results: Sales rose 2.6% to $329.2m; same-store sales were up only 0.6% and online sales slipped 1.4%.
Net income dipped to $48.0m from $48.7m as store and admin costs rose faster than sales.
Nine-month sales were up 4.3% and profit up 8.1%; the chain had 450 stores at quarter-end, 8 more than a year ago.

points: Merchandise margin rose on more own-brand sales and fewer markdowns, but higher occupancy costs from new stores pulled gross margin down.
Warm weather hurt denim sales early in the quarter; conditions have since cooled.
Women's sales rose about 4% and kids' about 14%, while men's were roughly flat.
About 8 new stores are planned next year, with outlet centres opening more options.
